title: Scribble-Scrabble Cuttlefish
statement: This small, round-eyed cuttlefish drifts up to the glass to meet every visitor, its skin rippling with looping, half-legible patterns, as if it's taking notes on you or drafting a thoughtful reply. Between conversations it hovers in the warm, lamplit kelp and tidies smooth slate pebbles into careful little stacks, always curious about what you'll ask next.
